{{Quote|One of my gracious master's scout units had the misfortune of discovering a new Colicoid nest while sweeping resistance hideouts. The... unlucky scout who managed to crawl back raved about a bloodthirsty creature I've determined to be a queen.|[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Gleelan]]|<ref name="TOR:DwtQ" />}}
The '''Kag'areth Queen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoid]] Queen of the [[Kag'areth]] nest of mutated Colicoids that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The Kag'areth overtook a [[Kag'areth Queen's Nest|facility]] near [[Camp Conquest|Camp Victory]] on the [[Gorinth Plateau]] and made it into their nest, with the Kag'areth Queen taking up residence in the lower levels. In his efforts to undermine his superior [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Sartius]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Pirrell]] hired a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] to attack the nest and [[Death/Legends|kill]] the queen, thereby riling up the Colicoids.<ref name="TOR:DwtQ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kag'areth Queen appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Bounty Hunter class mission on Balmorra.<ref name="TOR:DwtQ" />
